manualFollowUps: Before merging: create the free Cloudflare Pages project schood-ai (the same way schood-admission was created), so the first deploy-pages run can publish it. After merging, run the 'Configure Schood AI Domain' workflow to bind ai.schood.online.

Pages: merging publishes schood-ai (new app; nothing else changes visually). ai.schood.online is added to VITE_ALLOWED_RETURN_HOSTS, so every app is rebuilt and the platform's sign-in can return there. Until the function is deployed the app shows the landing page and a connection error after sign-in.

Database: supabase db push --linked from an isolated copy that adds only 20261030100000_schood_ai_core.sql to the installed migrations, keeping the 9 pending #220 payment migrations (20261010162000-20261010174000) excluded. Dry run first. It creates the ai_* tables (RLS on, no browser policies), the credit, caps and notification functions, and seeds one settings row (AI on, 1000 calls a day, 300 per person, 5000 per workspace), the OpenRouter provider, the free google/gemma-4-31b-it:free model and the default route. It touches no existing table.

Secrets (--project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel): supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://ai.schood.online; supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_BETA_USER_IDS=<comma-separated Schood user ids of the testers>; supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_GLOBAL_DAILY_CALLS=1000 (a ceiling the admin settings can only lower).

Secrets left unset on purpose for now: supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_SERVICE_SECRET=<openssl rand -hex 32> only when the Telegram coach worker ships (the same value goes into the worker); supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_PLUS_PRODUCT_ID=<id>, supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_FAMILY_PRODUCT_ID=<id>, supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_TEACHER_PRODUCT_ID=<id>, supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_TEACHER_PRO_PRODUCT_ID=<id>, supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_CENTRE_PRODUCT_ID=<id> and supabase secrets set SCHOOD_AI_CENTRE_PRO_PRODUCT_ID=<id> in the pricing release, when the products exist. With them unset only Schood admins and the beta allowlist can use AI; everyone else sees the examples and plans.

Model keys: no new secret. The seeded provider reads the existing OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Other providers are added later in the registry and name their own secret (for example supabase secrets set CLOUDFLARE_AI_API_TOKEN=<Workers AI token> for Whisper speech to text; never the Pages deploy token).

Edge, after the migration and secrets: supabase functions deploy schood-ai --project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel (verify_jwt = false is in supabase/config.toml; the function verifies every session itself).
verification: supabase migration list --linked shows 20261030100000 applied and the 9 #220 payment migrations still pending.
Anon REST: GET /rest/v1/ai_settings and /rest/v1/ai_providers return 401/permission denied (no browser access).
OPTIONS https://<project>.supabase.co/functions/v1/schood-ai/core/me with Origin https://ai.schood.online answers 204 with that origin allowed; without a token GET answers 401 unauthorized.

Signed in as a tester in SCHOOD_AI_BETA_USER_IDS on ai.schood.online: Home shows beta access and 2,000 credits; the Assistant streams an answer from the free model; Credits shows the 1-credit charge; ai_calls has the row with cost 0.
Signed in as a person not on the allowlist: Home shows the paywall, the Assistant shows 'This needs a Schood AI plan', and no ai_calls row is written.
ai.schood.online at 375px in uz, ru and en: landing, sign-in return, home, assistant, credits.

rollback.pages: Cloudflare Pages: leave schood-ai on its previous deployment or unbind ai.schood.online. Other apps only gained a return host; rolling them back is not needed.
rollback.migration: Additive and isolated: to switch AI off, update ai_settings set ai_enabled = false. To remove entirely, drop the ai_* tables and functions (nothing else references them).
rollback.edge: supabase functions delete schood-ai, or redeploy a previous version; no other function depends on it.
